event_name_zh: FTX 暂停提款至申请破产保护
event_name_en: FTX withdrawal suspension and Chapter 11 filing
description: The SEC complaint says FTX paused customer withdrawals on November 8, 2022. As Samuel Bankman-Fried sought funding, Binance announced a nonbinding acquisition proposal and then withdrew. On November 11, FTX Trading Ltd. filed a Chapter 11 petition in Delaware.
scope_include: Trace the withdrawal suspension, efforts to obtain funding, and the filing for Chapter 11 protection. End the inquiry at the filing.
scope_exclude: Subsequent restructuring, creditor distributions, and criminal proceedings against individuals.
